title: AI/ML Engineer / Data Scientist

path.note: Research roles often need a master's or PhD.

pros: Fastest-growing hiring segment even while overall IT hiring is flat
Work spans every industry (finance, health, retail)
cons: Most of the job is cleaning messy data, not building models
Fierce competition at entry level; strong offers often come only through internships
The field changes every few months, so burnout risk is real
Models fail in production in ways that are hard to explain to managers
sceneIdeas: The data has 30% missing values and the demo is tomorrow
The model scores 95% in the notebook and 60% in production
A manager asks "can't AI just do this?"
Deciding whether to ship a model you don't fully trust

sources.label: AI/ML postings +25% (Deccan Chronicle, World Bank data)
